_comment: ALLOWLIST, not a denylist — fail-closed by design (see
docs/proposals/config-only-deploy/context.md and
public-app/property-pages/infra/config-only-allowed-params.json for the
full rationale). A parameter not named here is unsafe-by-default.
Deliberately NOT listed, and why:
EnvironmentName            — identity of the stack itself.
LambdaRuntime              — changing the Node runtime without a real
rebuild against it is not a shortcut to allow.
LambdaCodeS3Bucket/Key     — LambdaCodeS3Key is a freshly timestamped
key only a real deploy's upload produces;
config-only mode never uploads anything,
so this must always carry forward the
live stack's current value.
EnableCloudFront           — flips whether a CloudFront Distribution
exists at all; a topology change.
EnableCustomDomainMapping  — creates/removes the BasePathMapping; a
topology change.
MarketplaceApiDomainName   — moves the mapping AND the CloudFront origin
to another domain; use a full deploy.
ModelProvider              — flips the Bedrock IAM grant on/off and
which SDK the Lambda talks to; a real
change that deserves a build + tests.
SesFromEmail               — adds/removes the ses:SendEmail grant; the
IAM change should go through a full deploy.
